A sequence starts at the selected comparison. Each case gets a fresh device, closes it when finished and has a 40-second deadline. After a failure, choose a later comparison only when you want to run another check.


The last report and each stage are saved only in this browser when storage is available. After a reload, an unfinished check stays visible until you tap Run. Use Clear to remove it. Reports are not uploaded; Copy includes the browser, adapter, diagnostic build and exact shader hashes.


Open the actual medium candidate renderer. Use this after both candidate compilation checks pass. Glass/water transport, stack capacity, traversal, geometry, reconstruction and random streams are retained. Remove mediumStack=inline to return to the default implementation.
